scope.geography: Greater Johannesburg Water Supply System / Johannesburg Water portfolio
scope.purpose: Establish a source-attributed public aggregate baseline and define data acquisition gates for research; do not use directly for hydraulic calibration.

source_records.publication_title: 2024/2025 Water Quality Report for Greater Johannesburg Water Supply System
source_records.granularity: System-wide 12-month sample summary and average values of selected constituents; no asset-level or sampling-site time series in this notice
reuse_terms: Attribute Johannesburg Water SOC Ltd as publisher and retain the source URL.
No open-data licence for this transcribed summary was confirmed in the notice; confirm permissions before commercial redistribution or bulk republication.
The original report and monthly reports remain at the linked publishers' sites; this bundle contains only limited transcribed aggregate values.
known_limitations: Published aggregate data cannot be used to calibrate pipe-level hydraulic pressure, demand, flow, or network topology.
The notice's E. coli-free percentage and average constituent table are distinct summaries and should not be conflated.
Reported units and thresholds are preserved as presented; the source excerpt labels colour in Hz.
The recorded period is 2024-07-01 through 2025-06-30; these data are not current telemetry.

source_records.granularity: City-wide forward-looking five-year programme targets; no per-asset schedule or as-built completion records on the page
reuse_terms: Attribute Johannesburg Water SOC Ltd and link to the published programme.
No separate open-data licence was confirmed for this page; the cited target is transcribed as a public aggregate, not a re-hosted source dataset.
known_limitations: The page describes plans, not completed work or a committed year-by-year phasing schedule.
The programme does not identify individual pipes, asset condition, diameter, material, pressure, or failure history.
Targets are portfolio context only and cannot serve as hydraulic inputs.

nonclaims: These observations do not contain individual sampling locations, raw laboratory result rows, time-series pressure, demand, flow, pipe topology, pipe condition, or sewer levels.
They do not calibrate EPANET or SWMM and do not prove local network hydraulic behaviour.
Reported aggregate values have not been independently reproduced from raw samples.
Water quality summaries and hydraulic service reliability are different evidence domains.
Published planned replacement kilometres are targets, not actual completed works.
No claim is made that the observations are a complete or current picture of Johannesburg's water system.
